title: model
description: Configuration of a single LinPipe model. Besides the fields listed here, a model may carry any number of model-specific parameters (e.g. 'tagsets').

timestamp.description: When this config was generated (ISO 8601 date-time).

name.description: Model name; should match its key in models.json.

family.description: The model family this model belongs to.

operations.description: Kinds of operations the model can respond to.

depends_on.description: Names of other models that this model depends on.

files.description: Files that belong to the model, usually a single archive to download and unpack.

name.description: File name, as stored locally after download.

url.description: Where to download the file from.

unpack.description: Whether the file is an archive that should be unpacked after download.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file, as 64 hex characters.
